records.title: Creativity and Machine Learning: A Survey
records.reason: The title is a general survey of creativity and machine learning, with no indicated inference-system efficiency focus.

records.title: MambaTAD: A Mamba-Based Contrastive Learning Framework for Time Series Anomaly Detection
records.reason: The title describes contrastive learning for time-series anomaly detection, an application-specific training framework rather than inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Extending the RANGE of Graph Neural Networks: Relaying Attention Nodes for Global Encoding
records.reason: The title concerns extending graph neural networks with attention nodes for global encoding, an independent graph-learning architecture without a stated LLM systems-efficiency connection.

records.title: Advantageous Parameter Expansion Training Makes Better Large Language Models
records.reason: The title explicitly studies parameter-expansion training for large language models, a training-quality method rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: On Surjectivity of Neural Networks: Can you elicit any behavior from your model?
records.reason: The title is a theoretical question about neural-network surjectivity and elicitable behavior, not an inference systems-efficiency method.

records.title: Unraveling the cognitive patterns of Large Language Models through module communities
records.reason: The title is an analysis of cognitive patterns and module communities in LLMs, an interpretability study rather than an inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: VCM: Vision Concept Modeling Based on Implicit Contrastive Learning with Vision-Language Instruction Fine-Tuning
records.reason: The title describes vision-concept modeling with vision-language fine-tuning, an independent vision application with no stated LLM serving or inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: GDKVM: Echocardiography Video Segmentation via Spatiotemporal Key-Value Memory with Gated Delta Rule
records.reason: GDKVM uses spatiotemporal key-value memory and gated delta-rule updates to retain video context with linear-time inference; this recurrent memory mechanism is transferable to efficient sequence-state handling, although the evaluation is echocardiography segmentation.

records.title: Weight Squeezing: Reparameterization for Knowledge Transfer and Model Compression
records.reason: Weight Squeezing transfers a teacher into a smaller student and evaluates BERT-Medium on GLUE; the abstract supports compression and smaller/faster training, but does not establish serving latency or inference-memory gains.

records.title: CodeSSM: Towards State Space Models for Code Understanding
records.reason: CodeSSM applies state-space models to code understanding and reports up to 64% memory savings over Transformer alternatives as context grows; this is a concrete transferable long-sequence memory-efficiency result.

records.title: Deep is a Luxury We Don't Have
records.reason: The paper replaces quadratic self-attention with linear self-attention for high-resolution mammography; the attention-complexity reduction is a transferable inference-compute method despite its medical-imaging evaluation.

records.title: COMET: A Framework for Modeling Compound Operation Dataflows with Explicit Collectives
records.reason: COMET models dataflows and explicit collectives for compound operations in LLMs and state-space models, targeting accelerator latency and energy; its hardware/dataflow analysis directly concerns inference efficiency.

records.title: ME-BERT: Multi-exit BERT by use of Adapter
records.reason: The stable DOI/title identify an inference-oriented ME-BERT paper, but the primary DOI landing URL returned `Internal Error ()` and the exact-DOI search exposed only secondary ResearchGate metadata; the publisher abstract was not retrievable.

records.title: Inverted Activations
records.reason: Inverted Activations reduces activation storage during neural-network training and evaluates GPT, BERT, Mistral, and Llama; the abstract establishes training-memory savings, not inference or serving savings.

records.title: A Theory of Inference Compute Scaling: Reasoning through Directed Stochastic Skill Search
records.reason: The paper formalizes inference-compute scaling for LLM reasoning as directed stochastic skill search, comparing reasoning strategies and resource costs; compute allocation at inference is central to the work.

records.title: Synthetic Intuition: A System-1/System-2 Architecture for Fast and Slow Thinking in Large Language Models
records.reason: Synthetic Intuition separates routine generation on a small System-1 model from selective System-2 reasoning; the official IEEE abstract reports 3.2× inference speedup and 68% lower cost.

records.title: Scorch: A Library for Sparse Deep Learning
records.reason: Scorch is a sparse deep-learning library with a compiler/runtime stack for sparse CPU inference; its abstract reports 1.05–5.78× speedups on supported workloads.

records.title: Entropy-Based Block Pruning for Efficient Large Language Models
records.reason: Entropy-Based Block Pruning selects LLM blocks for removal using entropy signals to reduce model size while preserving quality; the abstract directly supports efficient LLM deployment.

records.title: Scaling Fine-Grained MoE Beyond 50B Parameters: Empirical Evaluation and Practical Insights
records.reason: The paper empirically studies fine-grained MoE scaling to 50B parameters and gives practical architecture/training insights; its abstract does not establish a specific inference-latency, memory, or serving optimization.

records.title: Mixpert: Mitigating Multimodal Learning Conflicts with Efficient Mixture-of-Vision-Experts
records.reason: Mixpert dynamically routes multimodal inputs among vision experts to mitigate modality conflicts while avoiding the cost of multiple full encoders; this reduced-computation expert routing is transferable to efficient multimodal LLM inference.
